summary.title: Online Student Portal Threat Model
summary.description: An online university student portal where students can view examination results, lecturers can upload and modify marks, and administrators can manage user accounts. Student information and examination results are stored in a database, and the portal is accessible through the Internet.

diagrams.title: Online Student Portal Data-Flow Diagram
diagrams.description: Data-flow diagram showing the users, processes, database and data flows of the online student portal.
